title: El-Sayed Clashes With Former Primary Rival Who Demanded His Apology
summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed and Representative Haley Stevens traded sharply critical comments Friday, escalating intraparty tensions in Michigan’s pivotal Senate race.
